<circle cx="180" cy="108" r="2.5" fill="#1a0f04" stroke="none"/> <circle cx="220" cy="108" r="2.5" fill="#1a0f04" stroke="none"/>

<path d="M 180,315 L 170,360 L 180,385"/> <path d="M 220,315 L 230,360 L 220,385"/> Las piernas no descienden rectas sino con quiebre
